mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_todo ( id, conversation_id, title, due_time, status, source, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{conversationId}, #{title}, #{dueTime, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{source}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, title, due_time, status, source, created_at FROM student_todo WHERE id = #{id} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
SELECT id, conversation_id, title, due_time, status, source, created_at FROM student_todo WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY due_time ASC
SELECT id, conversation_id, title, due_time, status, source, created_at FROM student_todo WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY conversation_id, due_time ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_todo WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' AND created_at < #{cutoff, typeHandler=com.weida.bot.wechatilinkbot.persistence.mybatis.InstantTextTypeHandler}
